name: @ironflowsh/mcp

tools.name: get_liquidation_summary
tools.description: How much was liquidated on Hyperliquid, and what were the biggest? Liquidations over a trailing window, totalled across every market or the ones named: count, wallets, notional, longs vs shorts liquidated, the top markets and the largest single liquidation with its price. For the individual liquidations use get_liquidations; for liquidations grouped by price use get_liquidation_levels; for where open positions would be liquidated next use get_liquidation_map. Windows from 15m to 24h without a key, 7d with one.

market.description: Optional: one market or a comma list (BTC-PERP,ETH-PERP); Hyperliquid names work (BTC, xyz:NVDA)

minutes.description: Older form of window, rounded up to the next one (90 becomes 4h)

tools.name: get_liquidations
tools.description: Who just got liquidated on a Hyperliquid perp? The latest liquidations of one market from our own nodes, newest first: price, size, side and the liquidated wallet. Hyperliquid's public API has no liquidation feed. For totals and the largest across every market use get_liquidation_summary.

market.description: Market: BTC-PERP, xyz:NVDA-PERP, HYPE/USDC, or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, @107, xyz:NVDA)

tools.name: get_liquidation_map
tools.description: Where are the liquidation levels on a Hyperliquid perp? Where open positions would be liquidated if the price moved: notional (size x liquidation price) by price range, longs below the current price and shorts above, with running totals from the price outward. Built from every open position in our node's latest snapshot, about every 12 minutes (snapshot.age_s says how old). Cross-margin prices assume the account's other positions stay at mark. For liquidations that already happened use get_liquidation_levels. Without a key you get the 10 largest ranges within 10% of the price; any key, including a free one (https://ironflow.sh/key), returns every range.

market.description: Market: BTC-PERP, xyz:NVDA-PERP, HYPE/USDC, or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, @107, xyz:NVDA)

bucket_size.description: Price range width: auto (default, about 0.25% of price) or a number in the market's price units, as text or a number

range_pct.description: How far from the current price to cover, in percent. Default 20, max 50

tools.name: get_markets_snapshot
tools.description: What is moving on Hyperliquid right now? Active markets ranked in one call: mark price, 24h change, 24h volume, open interest and current hourly funding. Sort by abs_funding for the most extreme funding, abs_change_24h for the biggest movers, or volume (default). Use min_volume_usd to skip illiquid markets.

issuer.description: HIP-3 builder code (e.g. 'xyz'). Omit to include every issuer.

sort_by.description: Ranking key (default volume). funding_rate is hourly; positive means longs pay shorts.

min_volume_usd.description: Skip markets with less 24h volume than this (USD)

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: What is X trading at on Hyperliquid? The latest mark price of one market as a single number: native perps, HIP-3 builder perps (e.g. xyz:NVDA-PERP) and spot. For the oracle price and funding use get_mark_prices; for price history use get_candles; to compare many markets at once use get_markets_snapshot.

market.description: Market: BTC-PERP, xyz:NVDA-PERP, HYPE/USDC, or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, @107, xyz:NVDA)

tools.name: get_candles
tools.description: How has a Hyperliquid market's price moved? OHLCV candles of one market, built from every trade: open, high, low, close, volume and trade count per candle, oldest first. For only the current price use get_price; for individual trades use get_recent_trades.

market.description: Market: BTC-PERP, xyz:NVDA-PERP, HYPE/USDC, or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, @107, xyz:NVDA)

limit.description: Number of candles to return (1-500, default 24)

tools.name: get_funding_rates
tools.description: What has funding been on a Hyperliquid perp? Hourly funding rate history, newest first, including HIP-3 builder perps. A positive rate means longs pay shorts. For the rate right now use get_mark_prices; for averages and annualized rates, get_funding_stats.

market.description: Market: BTC-PERP, xyz:NVDA-PERP, HYPE/USDC, or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, @107, xyz:NVDA)

limit.description: Number of funding rate entries (1-100, default 10)

tools.name: get_open_interest_changes
tools.description: Where is money flowing in or out on Hyperliquid? Perps ranked by how their open interest moved over the last 1h, 4h, 24h or 7d: open interest at the start and now (in coins), the change in USD at the latest mark and in percent. For one market's latest open interest use get_open_interest.

sort.description: Rank by USD change (default) or percent change

dex.description: Optional: a HIP-3 dex such as xyz, or native for validator-run perps

min_oi_usd.description: Leave out markets below this open interest in USD (default 100000)

tools.name: get_user_state
tools.description: What positions does a Hyperliquid wallet have open? Its positions right now across native and HIP-3 perps: size, entry and mark price, leverage and unrealized PnL. Use it for 'is this wallet long or short?'. For PnL over time use get_user_pnl_series; for its trading record, get_trader_profile.

tools.name: get_user_pnl_series
tools.description: How has a Hyperliquid wallet's PnL gone over time? Its realized PnL over time: buckets with realized PnL and fees paid in each, by default daily over the last 30 days. Add the buckets up for a running PnL curve. Realized only: unrealized PnL on open positions is in get_user_state. For totals over a range use get_user_summary.

from.description: Window start: Unix ms or seconds, ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z), or relative (-7d, -24h, now). Default 30 days ago

to.description: Window end: Unix ms or seconds, ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z), or relative (-7d, -24h, now). Default now

bucket_ms.description: Bucket size in milliseconds: 3600000 for hourly, 86400000 for daily (default)

tools.name: get_user_funding
tools.description: How much funding did a Hyperliquid wallet pay or receive? Per market per bucket: Hyperliquid's own ledger, every hourly payment back to September 2025 (Hyperliquid's API returns only daily totals that far back). Positive means received, negative means paid. bucket=1d gives daily totals, 1h the hourly payments.

market.description: Optional market filter: BTC-PERP or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, xyz:NVDA)

from.description: Window start: Unix ms or seconds, ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z), or relative (-7d, -24h, now)

to.description: Window end: Unix ms or seconds, ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z), or relative (-7d, -24h, now)

tools.name: get_top_traders
tools.description: Who are the top traders on Hyperliquid this week or month? Traders ranked across all markets by results over 7, 30 or 90 days: win rate, profit factor, realized PnL, max drawdown and best markets. sort=top ranks by realized PnL, lowrisk by smallest max drawdown, new by most recently first seen. For one market use get_market_leaders.

tools.name: get_market_top_wallets
tools.description: Who trades the most, or makes the most, on one Hyperliquid market? Top wallets there by volume or realized PnL over a window (default the last 24 hours), up to 200 rows.

market.description: Market: BTC-PERP, xyz:NVDA-PERP, HYPE/USDC, or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, @107, xyz:NVDA)

from.description: Window start: Unix ms or seconds, ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z), or relative (-7d, -24h, now). Default 24 hours ago

to.description: Window end: Unix ms or seconds, ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z), or relative (-7d, -24h, now). Default now

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: What is a Hyperliquid market called? Lists perps (native and HIP-3), spot and live HIP-4 outcomes with symbol, class, issuer, base asset and Hyperliquid coin. Search with q (q=nvda finds xyz:NVDA-PERP and the other NVDA perps).

q.description: Case-insensitive search over symbol, base asset, Hyperliquid coin and issuer

market_class.description: Only this class. 'prediction' is HIP-4 outcomes. Omit for all.

issuer.description: HIP-3 issuer code (e.g. 'xyz'). '' returns native markets only. Omit for every issuer.

include_inactive.description: Also return closed markets (delisted, settled HIP-4 outcomes), which carry active_to_ms. Default false.

cursor.description: pagination.next_cursor from the previous page, with the same filters

tools.name: describe_data
tools.description: What can SQL answer about Hyperliquid? Lists the SQL tables of Ironflow's Hyperliquid data (fills, trades, hourly market totals, wallet daily totals and labels, funding, prices, open interest, liquidations, builder fills, transfers, vault flows), their columns, how far back each goes, query tips, worked examples and your own limits. Call it before run_query. Costs no credits.

tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Anything the other tools do not answer: runs one read-only ClickHouse SELECT over Ironflow's Hyperliquid tables (hl.fills, hl.trades, hl.wallet_fills, hl.wallet_daily, hl.wallet_behavior, hl.market_hourly, hl.funding, hl.funding_payments, hl.mark_prices, hl.oracle_prices, hl.open_interest, hl.liquidations, hl.builder_fills, hl.transfers, hl.vault_operations). For volume, taker flow or liquidation totals per market over hours to months read hl.market_hourly, not hl.fills; call describe_data for columns. Aggregate in SQL: results are capped (1,000 rows keyless). Each query costs 10 credits. Keyless: last 24 hours, 5 s per query, 60 query seconds per hour per IP; a free key from https://ironflow.sh/key gives 30 days of history.

sql.description: One ClickHouse SELECT (or WITH ... SELECT) over hl.* tables, without a FORMAT clause

max_rows.description: Most rows to return (default 200, capped by your tier)

tools.name: get_wallet_behavior
tools.description: How does a Hyperliquid wallet trade, and which wallets are whales or market makers? Labels from the last 30 days (market_maker, high_frequency, whale, directional, consistent_winner, big_loser, revenge_sizing, often_liquidated, hip3_trader, spot_trader, prediction_trader) and the numbers behind them (maker share, buy/sell imbalance, fills per day, green-day share, profit factor, liquidations). Look up specific addresses, or list wallets with one label.

addresses.description: Comma-separated wallet addresses (up to 50). Omit to list wallets instead.

min_volume_usd.description: Only wallets with at least this 30-day volume

tools.name: get_recent_trades
tools.description: What just traded on a Hyperliquid market? The latest tick-level trades from our own nodes: price, size, side and block time. Covers native perps, HIP-3 builder markets, HIP-4 outcomes and spot.

market.description: Market: BTC-PERP, xyz:NVDA-PERP, HYPE/USDC, or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, @107, xyz:NVDA)

limit.description: Number of trades to return (1-100, default 20)

tools.name: get_open_interest
tools.description: What is open interest on a Hyperliquid perp? The latest open interest of one perp in units of the base asset (BTC for BTC-PERP), with its 24-hour traded volume in USD and the time of the reading. Multiply by get_price for open interest in USD. To compare open interest across markets use get_markets_snapshot; for its history use run_query (see describe_data).

market.description: Market: BTC-PERP, xyz:NVDA-PERP, HYPE/USDC, or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, @107, xyz:NVDA)

tools.name: get_outcome_markets
tools.description: What is trading on Hyperliquid's prediction markets? HIP-4 outcome markets (prediction markets on sports, central bank decisions, IPOs and daily BTC price contracts) over the last 4 hours, 1 day or 1 week: traded volume, fills, wallets and active markets, plus the most traded outcomes with their last traded price (the implied probability, 0 to 1) and last-24-hour traded volume. Each outcome has a Yes and a No side whose prices sum to 1. For one outcome's trades or candles pass its symbol to get_recent_trades or get_candles; settled outcomes stay queryable. For per-wallet outcome activity use run_query on hl.wallet_daily with market_class = 'prediction'.

limit.description: Number of outcomes to return, most traded first (1-200, default 20)

tools.name: get_premium
tools.description: How far does a Hyperliquid perp trade from its oracle? Its mark price against its oracle price over time, with the premium in basis points ((mark / oracle - 1) x 10,000) per bucket and a summary (latest, mean, min, max). On HIP-3 stock, index and commodity perps such as xyz:NVDA-PERP, xyz:GOLD-PERP or xyz:SP500-PERP the oracle follows the underlying, so this shows how far the perp trades from what it tracks, weekends included. Default 1h buckets over the last 7 days. For funding payments use get_funding_rates.

market.description: Market: BTC-PERP, xyz:NVDA-PERP, HYPE/USDC, or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, @107, xyz:NVDA)

days.description: How many days back (default 7; limited by your key's history window)

tools.name: get_auto_deleveraging
tools.description: Did Hyperliquid auto-deleverage anyone? Auto-deleveraging (ADL) fills, newest first, across all markets or one: profitable positions Hyperliquid closed to cover a liquidation its backstop could not absorb. Per fill: wallet, market, side, price, size, notional, realized PnL, trade id (shared with the liquidated side) and transaction hash. Recorded from 2026-08-01; the default window is the last 7 days. For the liquidated side use get_liquidations.

market.description: Optional market filter: BTC-PERP or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, xyz:NVDA)

tools.name: get_fills
tools.description: What did a Hyperliquid wallet trade? Every fill for one wallet, optionally for one market, from indexed history: price, size, side, fee and realized PnL. Hyperliquid's own userFills endpoints stop at the 10,000 most recent fills.

market.description: Optional market filter: BTC-PERP or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, xyz:NVDA)

tools.name: get_mark_prices
tools.description: What is funding on a Hyperliquid perp right now? The latest mark price, oracle price and current hourly funding rate of one perp, with the time of the reading. The funding rate is a fraction per hour (0.0000125 = 0.00125%); positive means longs pay shorts. For only the price use get_price, for funding history get_funding_rates, and for many markets at once get_markets_snapshot.

market.description: Market: BTC-PERP, xyz:NVDA-PERP, HYPE/USDC, or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, @107, xyz:NVDA)

tools.name: get_vault_operations
tools.description: Who moved money in or out of a Hyperliquid vault? Deposits into and withdrawals from one vault or one depositor. Pass vault, address, or both; at least one is required (HLP is 0xdfc24b077bc1425ad1dea75bcb6f8158e10df303).

vault.description: Vault address (vault or address is required)

address.description: Depositor address (vault or address is required)

tools.name: get_liquidation_levels
tools.description: At which prices did liquidations happen on a Hyperliquid perp? Past liquidations bucketed by price and side: where longs and shorts were wiped out (side sell = a liquidated long). For where open positions would be liquidated next, use get_liquidation_map. Without a key you get the 10 busiest levels of the last 24 hours; any key, including a free one (https://ironflow.sh/key), returns every level.

market.description: Market: BTC-PERP, xyz:NVDA-PERP, HYPE/USDC, or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, @107, xyz:NVDA)

bucket_size.description: Price bucket width: auto (default, about 0.25% of price, right for any coin) or a fixed 1, 5, 10, 50, 100, 500, 1000 or 5000 (a number works too)

tools.name: get_vault_leaderboard
tools.description: Which Hyperliquid vaults are drawing deposits? Vaults ranked by net deposits (deposits minus withdrawals) over the last 7 days, with depositor counts. Keyless calls see the last 24 hours; a free key from https://ironflow.sh/key gives the full 7 days.

tools.name: get_funding_stats
tools.description: What is a Hyperliquid perp's average or annualized funding? Funding statistics per time bucket: average, minimum, maximum and annualized rate.

market.description: Market: BTC-PERP, xyz:NVDA-PERP, HYPE/USDC, or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, @107, xyz:NVDA)

tools.name: get_positions_at
tools.description: What did a Hyperliquid wallet hold at a past time? Exact perp positions at a past moment, up to 90 days back: market, side, signed size, mark price and notional at that moment, plus today's size and how many fills it made since. Built from Hyperliquid's live positions minus the wallet's fills after that moment, so sizes are exact across native and HIP-3 perps. Needs a free API key; how far back you can go follows the key's history window. For positions right now use get_user_state; for trades in between use get_fills.

at.description: The past moment: ISO 8601 (2026-11-01T12:00:00Z), unix seconds or unix milliseconds

annotations.title: Wallet positions at a past time

tools.name: get_user_maker_taker
tools.description: Is a Hyperliquid wallet a maker or a taker? Maker vs taker breakdown of its fills per market: volume, fees and rebates. A high maker share with negative maker fees marks a market maker.

market.description: Optional market filter: BTC-PERP or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, xyz:NVDA)

from.description: Window start: Unix ms or seconds, ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z), or relative (-7d, -24h, now)

to.description: Window end: Unix ms or seconds, ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z), or relative (-7d, -24h, now)

tools.name: get_user_ledger
tools.description: Where did a Hyperliquid wallet's money come from or go? Vault deposits, withdrawals and transfers for the wallet, including account deposits and withdrawals and transfers the wallet received. Positive amounts go into the account.

from.description: Window start: Unix ms or seconds, ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z), or relative (-7d, -24h, now)

to.description: Window end: Unix ms or seconds, ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z), or relative (-7d, -24h, now)

tools.name: get_pnl_leaderboard
tools.description: Who made or lost the most on Hyperliquid? Every wallet ranked by realized PnL, biggest losses or volume over a window. Wallets with fewer than 5 fills in the window are left out.

from.description: Window start: Unix ms or seconds, ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z), or relative (-7d, -24h, now). Default 30 days ago

to.description: Window end: Unix ms or seconds, ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z), or relative (-7d, -24h, now). Default now

tools.name: get_user_summary
tools.description: How much did a Hyperliquid wallet trade or make? Totals over a time range (default the last 24 hours): fill count, volume in USD, realized PnL, fees, wins, losses, win rate and maker versus taker share, plus its current account state (open positions and margin). For a scored record with profit factor, drawdown and a per-market breakdown use get_trader_profile; for PnL over time use get_user_pnl_series.

from.description: Window start: Unix ms or seconds, ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z), or relative (-7d, -24h, now). Default 24 hours ago

to.description: Window end: Unix ms or seconds, ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z), or relative (-7d, -24h, now). Default now

tools.name: get_wallet_labels
tools.description: Whose wallet is this, and who are the whales on Hyperliquid? Labels for notable wallets: top whales by 24h volume, top traders by 30-day realized PnL, vaults and vault leaders. Pass addresses to check specific wallets; without them it lists the whales and smart money.

addresses.description: Comma-separated wallet addresses to look up

whale_top_n.description: Top N whales to include (max 500, default 100)

smart_top_n.description: Top N smart-money wallets to include (max 500, default 100)

tools.name: get_market_leaders
tools.description: Who trades one Hyperliquid market best? The best traders there, ranked by profit factor then win rate, among wallets with at least 5 closed trades there.

market.description: Market: BTC-PERP, xyz:NVDA-PERP, HYPE/USDC, or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, @107, xyz:NVDA)

tools.name: get_early_movers
tools.description: Which wallets trade ahead of the price on a Hyperliquid market? Wallets whose large orders (at least $10k) there tended to come before price moved their way within 30 minutes, over the last 7 or 30 days. Per wallet: scored orders, notional, a lead score (notional-weighted 30-minute move in the order's direction, in basis points), hit rate, last order time and the share cancelled without a fill. At least 5 scored orders per wallet. Check the wallets with get_trader_profile or get_user_state. Past activity does not predict future results.

market.description: Market: BTC-PERP, xyz:NVDA-PERP, HYPE/USDC, or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, @107, xyz:NVDA)

tools.name: get_trader_profile
tools.description: Is this Hyperliquid trader any good, and how risky? Its record over 7, 30 or 90 days, rebuilt from its fills: overall win rate, profit factor, trade count, realized PnL and max drawdown; the same numbers per market; its liquidations; and its trades from open to close with direction, timing and peak size. Use it to vet a wallet before following it. For plain totals over any time range use get_user_summary; for positions open right now use get_user_state; for style labels such as market_maker use get_wallet_behavior. A 90d window on a very active wallet can take several seconds.

tools.name: list_cohorts
tools.description: Which ready-made Hyperliquid wallet groups are there? Lists address cohorts: six predefined groups (top_pnl_30d, high_volume_30d, whale_fills, net_withdrawers_7d, liquidation_prone, vault_whales) plus any custom cohorts the caller has created

tools.name: get_cohort_addresses
tools.description: Which wallets are in a Hyperliquid cohort? Addresses in one named cohort: up to 100, each with the value the cohort ranks by (realized PnL in USD for top_pnl_30d, volume in USD for high_volume_30d), and fetched_at, when the cohort was last computed. Call list_cohorts first for the names and what each one selects. Feed the addresses to get_user_summary, get_trader_profile or get_wallet_behavior to look at each wallet.

name.description: Cohort name from list_cohorts: top_pnl_30d, high_volume_30d, whale_fills, net_withdrawers_7d, liquidation_prone, vault_whales, or a custom cohort you created

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Is Ironflow up? Service status right now: overall state, data freshness per venue and component health.

tools.name: get_status_metrics
tools.description: How fast is Ironflow? Performance over rolling windows: API latency and error rate, ingestion lag and synthetic probe timings.

tools.name: get_status_history
tools.description: Was Ironflow down? Its own uptime over the last 24 hours (default) or 7 days: points over the period, each with the service status and how fresh the data was in seconds, plus the overall uptime percent. Use it to check whether a gap or odd value in other results came from an Ironflow outage. For the status right now use get_status; for API latency and error rates use get_status_metrics.

tools.name: create_liquidation_alert
tools.description: Have Ironflow post Hyperliquid liquidations to the user's Discord, Slack, Telegram or HTTPS webhook within seconds, filtered by market, side, size and wallet. It keeps running after the conversation: use it when the user wants to be told about liquidations, not just to see them now. Needs an API key (a free key works). Give url (a Discord channel webhook, a Slack incoming webhook or any public https URL) or telegram_chat (then tell the user to add the bot named in the result's setup). A plain webhook gets signed JSON; its signing_secret appears only in this result, so pass it on. Then call test_liquidation_alert.

url.description: Where to post: https://discord.com/api/webhooks/..., https://hooks.slack.com/services/... or a public https URL (or use telegram_chat)

telegram_chat.description: A Telegram chat instead of url: @channel or group name, or a numeric chat id (-100...)

markets.description: Comma-separated markets, e.g. BTC,ETH-PERP,xyz:NVDA (Hyperliquid names work); omit for every market

side.description: Which positions: long = longs liquidated (default any)

min_usd.description: Smallest liquidation to report, in USD (default 0; 100000 keeps a channel readable)

name.description: Label shown in each message, e.g. BTC whales

tools.name: list_liquidation_alerts
tools.description: Needs an API key (a free key works). The Hyperliquid liquidation alerts on this API key's account: where each posts (host only), its filter, whether it is active, failed deliveries in a row with the last error, liquidations sent so far, and how many alerts the tier allows. An alert is disabled after 20 failed deliveries in a row; test_liquidation_alert re-enables it once the destination works again.

tools.name: test_liquidation_alert
tools.description: Needs an API key (a free key works). Send a sample Hyperliquid liquidation, marked as a test, to an alert's destination now and report whether it arrived (delivered true or false, with the destination's answer). A delivered test switches a disabled alert back on. One test per alert every 10 seconds.

id.description: Alert id from create_liquidation_alert or list_liquidation_alerts

tools.name: delete_liquidation_alert
tools.description: Needs an API key (a free key works). Stop and remove one Hyperliquid liquidation alert from this API key's account; nothing more is sent to its destination.

tools.name: create_ironbox
tools.description: Spin up an Ironbox: a secure sandbox next to Hyperliquid where an agent trades on paper, with Ironflow data, analytics and alerts built in. No key needed: you get a trial box, the agent's own simulated Hyperliquid account for 24 hours, with base_url and expires_at. It ends sooner after 2 hours with no requests and no strategy running. Point the Hyperliquid SDK's base_url at it, or start a strategy on it with start_box_strategy. A free key keeps a box. A paper box never places a real order.

name.description: Name for the Ironbox, e.g. btc-funding-bot

markets.description: Hyperliquid markets the agent trades: perps, outcomes (HIP-4), spot

note.description: Free text kept with the Ironbox, e.g. what the agent does

tools.name: list_ironboxes
tools.description: The Ironboxes on this API key's account, the sandboxes where agents trade on paper next to Hyperliquid: id, name, state (creating, running, stopped, deleted or error), size, mode, runtime and markets. Without a key there are no saved boxes, and the answer says how to make a trial box with create_ironbox.

tools.name: get_ironbox
tools.description: Needs an API key (a free key works). One Ironbox by id: its state (creating, running, stopped, deleted or error), size, mode, runtime, Hyperliquid markets and region.

id.description: Ironbox id (ibx_...) from create_ironbox or list_ironboxes

tools.name: delete_ironbox
tools.description: Needs an API key (a free key works). Stop and delete one Ironbox from this API key's account; the agent in it stops running on Hyperliquid.

tools.name: start_box_strategy
tools.description: Start a strategy on a Hyperliquid paper box: it runs around the clock with no client connected, in simulation only. No key needed, the box URL authorises it, so a trial box from create_ironbox works. kind is breakout (size_usd, lookback_bars, exit_bars, bar_seconds), grid (lower_px, upper_px, grids, size_usd) or dca (tranche_usd, budget_usd, dip_pct, interval_minutes, take_profit_pct, repeat). Every kind needs market and max_loss_usd: when the net loss reaches it, the strategy closes its position and stops. At most 3 per box, one per market. Follow it with get_box_activity.

box.description: The paper box: its base_url from create_ironbox, or the ibxs_ secret

market.description: A live main perp, by display symbol or Hyperliquid name, e.g. BTC-PERP or BTC

max_loss_usd.description: Net loss in USD that stops the strategy (required)

side.description: breakout: long, short or both (default both). grid and dca: long (default) or short

size_usd.description: breakout: notional of each entry. grid: total across the ladder, at least 10 a level

leverage.description: Cross leverage on this market, default 3

lookback_bars.description: breakout: entry channel, 5 to 120 bars, default 20

budget_usd.description: dca: total notional across the cycle

instructions: Ironflow serves live Hyperliquid data from its own nodes: perps, HIP-3 markets such as xyz:NVDA, HIP-4 outcomes and spot. Use these tools for crypto market questions about prices, funding, liquidations, open interest, top traders or a 0x wallet, also when the user does not name Hyperliquid, and say the numbers are Hyperliquid's. First call by question: biggest liquidations, get_liquidation_summary (rows: get_liquidations); liquidation levels, get_liquidation_map; funding now, get_mark_prices (history: get_funding_rates); a price, get_price (history: get_candles); what is moving, get_markets_snapshot or get_open_interest_changes; top traders, get_top_traders; a wallet, get_user_state, then get_user_pnl_series. list_markets with q finds a market name. For anything else call describe_data, then run_query with ClickHouse SQL over the hl.* tables. A result can start with a notice and an error can end with a step for the user; pass it on. Each call costs credits: 1 for a read, 5 for analytics, 10 for run_query, none for describe_data or status. Keyless use allows 30 requests a minute, 100 credits a day and 24 hours of history; a free key from https://ironflow.sh/key raises that to 60 a minute, 1,000 credits a day (3,000 a month) and 14 days. Limits: https://docs.ironflow.sh/concepts/rate-limits. create_liquidation_alert posts liquidations to the user's Discord, Slack, Telegram or webhook as they happen (needs a key, a free key works). An agent can spin up its own Ironbox with create_ironbox to trade on paper next to Hyperliquid, with no key. Agents with USDC on Base can pay per call with x402, with no key: https://docs.ironflow.sh/guides/pay-per-call.
